review: Three fixed-pose contact studies reviewed. v1 still smile/point shaped. v2 inadvertently moved pixels outside oral influence because corner shift was nonzero outside profile; withdrawn. v3 bounds the shift but OO has a blocky cavity and loses the painted lip detail. Do not describe rounded geometry as an approved improvement. AH/EE/rest remain controls.
decision: Keep previously anchored proof as best unapproved candidate; do not continue arbitrary rounded-hole warping as production solution. Need authored coordinated mouth poses with lip thickness and cavity material, or a demonstrated whole-character native speech renderer.
